findings.summary: The required README claim includes the brief-review phase, but D6's required evidence does not record it and the D6 gate cannot prove that part of the claim.
findings.evidence: D3 requires the README to say mai-code-2 ran "every session kind but the second review (plan, gate review, work, review, verify and brief review)" in the URL-shortener acceptance run and B40-B44, and says that sentence is backed by D6. D6 instead requires the section to record "every session kind they ran (plan, gate review, work, review and verify; no second review ran)" and shapes the D6 gate around only B40-B44 task counts, first-pass counts and costs. The B40-B44 brief headers do record vloop brief review on Copilot/mai-code-2, but their vloop metrics files cover run phases only, so the evidence section needs to name brief review separately rather than leave the D3 claim unsupported.
findings.fix: In D6, state explicitly that B40-B44's vloop brief review sessions also ran on mai-code-2, distinguish those sessions from the five run phases and explain that they are evidence but are outside vloop metrics cost totals. If the URL-shortener acceptance brief was reviewed too, name that evidence explicitly; otherwise scope D3 to B40-B44 for brief review. Add the corresponding literal to the D6 gate so the README claim cannot land without its evidence.

decisions: Keep Claude-specific passages unchanged while making genuinely shared passages name both agents; sound and keeps the agent differences readable.
Give mixed macOS/Windows teams a short README section that links to the full configuration-guide treatment; sound for avoiding duplicated rules that can drift.
Report mai-code-2's measured runs without calling it qualified by the eval rule; required by the existing qualification rule.
Include this repository's operator and architect skills because their BSD-tools wording is now false for the shared pwsh configuration; sound and narrowly scoped.
Do not pin source line numbers, and keep Spanish templates and docs/domain out of scope; sound for a moving documentation pass.
checked: facts, consistency, rules, runnability; brief check passed on a ready copy with 0 warnings; B40-B44 task, first-pass and cost figures checked against .vloop/state/metrics; current README, guides, install section, driver adapters and binding rules checked
